run_convert_checkpoint: run the conversion script to convert an EoMT-DINOv3 checkpoint from the official repo to Hugging Face Transformers format
list_supported_models: list all supported EoMT-DINOv3 checkpoint model IDs and their backbone configurations
verify_conversion: verify the converted Hugging Face model matches the original EoMT-DINOv3 model outputs within tolerance
push_converted_model: push the converted EoMT-DINOv3 model and processor to the Hugging Face Hub
resolve_checkpoint_spec: resolve an EoMT-DINOv3 checkpoint spec by model ID to get backbone repo and image size
